title: Native lane build should configure a fresh tree before a build-only action
body: On a fresh native checkout, tools/vixen-native.sh ... build build vixen-ninja gpu_systems_check reached build.bat without a configured build/ninja and failed with 'build/ninja is not a directory'; the documented recovery was rerunning with build all. The wrapper should either configure automatically for build-only on an unconfigured tree or fail early with a located remediation.

title: Native CTest batch argument escaping must support alternation regexes
body: A supported native GPU-suite invocation with -R '^Application\.LookdevCapture\.State\.(midday|late-afternoon|overcast|night-service)$' reached run-native-gpu-suite.bat but cmd.exe failed with '$ was unexpected'; the equivalent prefix regex worked. vixen-native.sh documents caret escaping for |, but the batch VIXEN_NATIVE_ARGS path still needs an end-to-end escaping contract for CTest regex arguments.

title: Native capture witnesses need an explicit persistent-root workflow
body: A successful queued GPU CTest run uses a private VIXEN_CAPTURE_ROOT and deletes it after success, leaving no artifacts for the required byte-hash comparison; the lane had to manually set VIXEN_CAPTURE_ROOT to a native-tree evidence directory and rerun. The native GPU runner should expose a documented persistent evidence-root option and retain/report its path automatically.

title: Native run-root registration must tolerate an existing PID marker
body: A queued native GPU run emitted Register-NativeRunRoot.ps1 Move-Item 'Cannot create a file when that file already exists' while the build continued. The registration helper should make the marker update atomic/idempotent or surface a located failure before the payload proceeds.

title: Native lane bootstrap should pre-provision or locate the pinned toolchain before GPU builds
body: The first own-lane native build had to clone C:/vixen-native/tilebinorder1 and provision the pinned Ninja/CMake/.NET toolchain before any target could run; the build-only attempt then failed on the still-unconfigured tree. The lane runner should expose a single preflight that guarantees checkout, toolchain, and configured tree, or reports each missing prerequisite before consuming a build slot.

title: Queue admission should retry resident-core identity timeouts as an infrastructure state
body: Three queued GPU witness admissions were refused before payload start because the resident box-queue core identity RPC timed out for 10 seconds even while the health endpoint returned HTTP 200; later short build admission recovered. The live wrapper should distinguish a transient core RPC timeout from an unusable service and retry/back off or emit a located operator action without requiring a lane to resubmit manually.

title: Native wrapper should fail before syncing when the source worktree is dirty
body: A phase-order GPU check was launched while the VIXEN source change was uncommitted; tools/vixen-native.sh warned that only the committed tip would be synchronized, then built the previous bare-order commit and produced a misleading SCHED004 red. The wrapper should make dirty-source test/build attempts fail early with the exact commit required, or provide an explicit reviewed dirty-tree mode.
